types.embedHelp: Google Forms, Typeform, Tally, Jotform or Calendly
types.collectionHelp: Latest posts, products and other published items
types.galleryHelp: Several photos in a grid or carousel
types.columnsHelp: 2 to 4 columns with icon, title and text
types.faqHelp: Questions that open their answer on click
types.contactHelp: Phone, WhatsApp, e-mail, address and map
types.heroHelp: Big title, a sentence and a button at the top
types.spacerHelp: Room or a line between blocks

fields.embedUrlHelp: Paste the sharing link from Google Forms, Typeform, Tally, Jotform or Calendly.
fields.embedInvalid: This link was not recognized. Use the full address of a Google Forms, Typeform, Tally or Jotform form, or a Calendly page. Short links (such as forms.gle) do not work: open the link and copy the address from the browser bar.
fields.faqHelp: Search engines may show these questions right in the results.
fields.question: Question
fields.hoursHelp: One line per day or period. E.g. Mon to Fri: 8am to 6pm
fields.showMapHelp: Shows the address on a Google map. Fill in the full address.
fields.videoUrlHelp: Copy the address of the video on YouTube or Vimeo and paste it here.
fields.videoInvalid: This link was not recognized. Use the address of a YouTube or Vimeo video.
fields.videoTitleHelp: For people who use a screen reader.
fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Supporting sentence
fields.textHelp: Use **bold**, *italic*, lists with "- " and links like [text](https://address).
fields.altHelp: For screen readers and search engines. E.g. The shop front at night.
fields.caption: Caption
fields.linkHelp: A page of the site (/contact) or a full address (https://…).
fields.linkInvalid: Use a site address starting with / or a full link starting with https://

images.deleteDescription: {{name}} is not in the draft or on the site and will be deleted for good. Old versions in the history that used it lose it.
images.someSkipped: Some files are not images and were left out.
images.library: Or pick an image already uploaded here
images.onlyImages: Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
images.missing: The image is no longer available.

connected.missing: The chosen item is no longer available. Choose another one.
connected.formHelp: Submissions arrive as contacts in the system, like the other forms.
connected.formEmpty: No active form. Create one in Forms.
connected.bookingHelp: Visitors pick the day and time on the booking page.
connected.bookingEmpty: No active booking link. Create one in Booking.
connected.collectionHelp: Only items already published on the site show up.
connected.collectionEmpty: No installed plugin offers content for this block.
connected.scopeHelp: Show only the items of one collection, such as the Blog.
